A dramatic European comeback, have Celtic finally found their spark? It's the SPFL weekend preview
Scottish Football Podcast
Available for 29 days
After a dramatic European comeback, have Celtic finally found the spark their season badly needed? Andy Burke is joined by Scott Allan and Gordon Waddell to ask whether they can now build momentum against Kilmarnock. With injury-hit Hearts struggling, can in-form Falkirk take advantage at Tynecastle? Can Rangers keep up the title pressure when they travel to St Mirren? Plus, they look ahead to the Tayside derby, Aberdeen against Hibs and ask whether Motherwell can follow up their long-awaited win when they visit Dundee United. 00:02:11 — Is Celtic’s comeback a turning point? 00:05:21 — Hearts’ injury crisis deepens 00:06:51 — Can flying Falkirk punish Hearts? 00:11:35 — Celtic look to kick on against Killie 00:15:16 — Can Rangers keep the pressure on? 00:19:50 — Tayside derby and the Saturday Premiership battles
